text_en: My my, how exciting to have real mermaids on board!
I like the Three Mermaids -- they're kind of funny and nice. Don't you, #username#?
Looking forward to the Mermaids' show today!
I can't wait to arrive in Nassau! Bahamas, here we come!
How long till we get to the Bahamas already?

I've found a recipe for happiness! Love what you do and you'll do what you love!
